name_vi: Ghế đôi quay lưng chung khung
description_en: A double chair with two opposite-facing woven seats sharing one central tall back frame; the front shows one complete seat, the side reveals the mirrored seat platforms on either side, and the rear shows the second seat with its own arm openings and stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic catalog photograph of a BACK-TO-BACK DOUBLE ARMCHAIR, a single joined furniture unit. Exactly TWO identical chairs face opposite directions 180 degrees apart along the FRONT-TO-REAR axis and share ONE central rectangular woven back frame. FRONT CAMERA: perfectly straight-on frontal elevation of the NEAR chair at seat height. The FAR chair is directly behind the central back and its seat is OCCLUDED from the front camera. Therefore the front silhouette looks like ONE normal armchair, with one visible rectangular seat, one visible rectangular back, two curved armrests and ordinary legs. Absolutely NO lateral side-facing seats, no side wings, no seat platforms extending left or right, no three-seat arrangement, no central spike/mast. refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Main woven seat and back close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish natural matte honey-tan fibers. Smooth bamboo frame with strong plain bindings and wood support rails. Whole single joined object visible with generous margins, square image, plain warm-white studio background, soft light, sharp fibers, no props, no people. NO TEXT OR MARKINGS: no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions, watermarks or symbols anywhere.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
